svg.text: One machine per site — broker, hub and detector together
Each preset is self-contained. Nothing below requires a second machine.
Preset A — Jetson Single Box
camera :554 → TensorRT detector → mosquitto → hub
all three containers on the same Jetson
detector · mosquitto · hub — workbench on :8090
4.13 ms p50 inference, 8.5-12.5% of one core
decode on NVDEC, confirmed in-kernel
Preset B — RK3588 Single Box
camera :554 → NPU detector → mosquitto → hub
all three containers on the same RK3588 board
detector · mosquitto · hub — workbench on :8090
41.9 ms p50 inference, NPU 8%, 21% of one core
the hub adds 3.7% of one core and 52.8 MB here
Preset C — Hailo Single Box
camera :554 → Hailo-8 detector → mosquitto → hub
all three containers on the same Pi 5 + Hailo-8
detector · mosquitto · hub — workbench on :8090
7.7 ms p50 inference, 8.7-13.0% of one core
no H.264 decoder here, so decode runs on the CPU
Optional expansion — Shared Hub
Only when several detector boxes already run and you want one alert list across them: repoint each detector's
mqtt_host at a separate always-on machine running broker + hub. Detectors do not have to match: a TensorRT Jetson
and an RKNN RK3588 were verified reporting into one device list, one alert list and one preview proxy.
optional: detections + status over MQTT to a shared hub
Topics: sensecraft/security/<device_id>/detections/<stream_id> · /status · /snapshot/<event_id> · /events/<stream_id>
The hub judges rules only for detectors that carry track ids. Devices that judge on their own publish events directly.
